findings.detail: The product bounds/detaches ordinary finite reports and duplicate-free request JSON before operation imports, verifies all four independently supplied original pins, and accepts only the exact authored source-unbound relational request profile. Original reports are replayed through the existing public relational validator before diagnostic work.

The product rebuilds TypedExpression through its existing public owner and compares complete validated roots with the existing bounded LogicExpressionAlgebra.alpha_equivalent. It neither constructs a replacement AST nor calls semantic_identity or an inferred legal-equivalence rule.
findings.topic: no new AST or equivalence owner

findings.detail: Exact serialization includes all original identities/digest. Declared projection removes only named expression/node/signature IDs and the derived expression digest, and normalizes signature declarations/role-row order without reordering arguments or connective children. Alpha agreement additionally requires actual normalized signature, family/profile and ordered-role agreement.

Shared algebra preserves ordered child recursion, quantifier kinds/binding, predicate symbols and extension family/profile/payload/features. Within the strict one-Object relational profile, alpha does not erase capture, ordered role changes, implication direction or O/P/F placement. Binder spelling remains observable in the separate declared outcome.

Feature extraction traverses the whole existing validated expression and cross-checks authoritative mapping order/path/kind/node/binder identity. It includes explicit binder and extension rows, ordered child paths, argument index/role, lexical binding quantifier path and modal/connective ancestry. The ledger preserves the complete reference-first ordered path union and explicit missing-side nulls, without favorable subtree remapping.

The new owner fences its own source and fixed trusted operation/native-producer closure through bounded regular nofollow reads across replay/projection/serialization. Offered producer maps are never used as filenames; they must first match independently replayed reports and the trusted fixed closure. Full-output validation requires independent pin and exact original-bound regeneration.
findings.topic: source fences and untrusted producer filenames

findings.detail: Static authored tests cover identity-only changes, complete bound-variable renames, declaration order, argument/capture/quantifier/connective/modal/role differences, missing path populations, input/report substitution, unproved producer filenames, finite preflight, complete result bounds and same-process real-source public-import controls. No test execution or collected-case count is claimed by this audit.

The closed config selects exactly A/B typed requests from the independently pinned published30-input descriptor and original native export file-index/seal. Source/config and preexisting result/execution/durability metadata joins were inspected without reading the two requests. The helper will read and compare those exact original/export bytes only under its new native owner and guard all selected metadata/request identities before/after.

Seven named checks comprise fresh current-root public relational prepare/validate, AA/BB identity controls, AB/BA modal distinction, saved-byte public comparison validation, two required refusal controls, and selected input/source/output closing guards. It never calls the old producer main or replays source HTML/scope/join. Saved comparison validation remains in the same new consumer interpreter.

The helper uses exact existing V03 checked-buffer guard, native-only outputs, offline/one-thread redirects, denied network/extra-child operations and a fresh product namespace. It checks selected originals/export copies plus metadata, not the complete old producer tree or live ledger/scheduler. Final durability/stopped group/storage and lease release remain the new native parent obligation.
findings.topic: native and old custody claims remain scoped

findings.detail: Guide/README/plan distinguish exact identity, declared structure and lexical alpha outcomes; all require valid paired inputs. They explicitly exclude aggregate decoder accuracy and batch missing/malformed/duplicate/abstention coverage, reviewed meaning, semantic/gold admission or actual training/Lake execution. Existing source-equivalence and review gaps remain open; prior association/typed-source work retains separate domains.

Request/report/output bounds and full mapping union limits are explicit. Product output overflow refuses, preserving the original inputs. No authority is inferred from successful replay; every flag stays false and training/evaluation-gold masks are integer zero.

limitations: Actual original/export typed-request bytes and new output reports were deliberately not opened or hashed by this audit. Their runtime replay remains pending under the admitted native helper.
Preexisting native metadata described a completed producer and selected export commitments; this audit does not authenticate old live scheduler/ledger state or complete-tree immutability.
Qualification/retained-comparison execution outcomes and final native closeout must be reviewed separately; no passed-case count or actual pair result is asserted here.
Read-only Python guards are cooperative, not OS network isolation, kernel quota or arbitrary descendant containment.
Paired syntax diagnostics do not supply a legal accuracy denominator, reviewed target, source correspondence decision, model result or training eligibility.
